To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
tender coconut water and pulp can be used as an ingredient in the preparation of jam.

the addition of tender coconut water to the dough of bread, muffins, and cakes increases the total soluble solid, total sugar, reducing sugar, non-reducing sugar, total protein, and fat content of the product and decreases the acidity and moisture content of the products.
the addition of tender coconut water in fruit juices can enhance the nutritional quality, and that the addition of 10% tender coconut water in pineapple, mango, and papaya juice is the best.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the standardisation of a tender coconut pulp (TCP) and papaya (PAP) jam.
the standardisation and quality evaluation for tender coconut pulp and pineapple pulp based jam.
the development of a new method for the preparation of a new method.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the quality of the coconut water is not affected by the storage conditions of the coconut fruit, but that it is the processing conditions of the coconut water after the fruit is harvested, which are the most important factors affecting the quality of the product.
tender coconut water is a healthy and safe beverage.
the use of the tender coconut pulp as a substitute for fruit pulp in the preparation of fruit pulp jam has been found to be a successful venture.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the addition of tender coconut water in the formulation of jam has a significant impact on the quality of the product.
tender coconut pulp is a good source of nutrients and it is a good ingredient to be used as a functional food in various food products.
the standardisation of tender coconut pulp jam was successfully done by adding 25% tender coconut pulp to fruit pulps of pineapple, mango and papaya and 20% tender coconut pulp with grapes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the tender coconut pulp has high nutritional values and is a good source of dietary fibre, minerals and vitamins.
the quality of the tender coconut pulp was significantly affected when the pulp was exposed to the sun.
the quality of the tender coconut water is affected by the storage time and the temperature.
